findings.statement: Pupil persistence remains the development-selected one-second forecast and transfers to the reserved animal

reliability.rationale: Persistence0.667284 pixels versus flexible0.677521 on one held animal is a bounded reproduction; all tested extensions fail to beat the selected control. Claim-specific scope: Pupil persistence remains the development-selected one-second forecast and transfers to the reserved animal

mechanism.rationale: Pixel-scale optical traces and prior1Hz author filtering do not identify cholinergic or mechanical causes. Prefix causality is product-space only.

novelty.rationale: Primary-source analyses and established equation families are disclosed. This review does not establish exhaustive literature novelty or a new universal law.

significance.rationale: Useful as a transparent bounded research/evaluation case. Only three animals; region and preparation confounded; no millimetre calibration, camera-latency or population precision claim.

reproducibility.rationale: Exact task, equation/state, group evidence, native semantics and provenance inspected; separate computational review is responsible for complete replay.

impact.rationale: No independent deployment, intervention, cost saving or clinical/industrial acceptance outcome was measured.

reliability.rationale: All saved predictions and primary metrics independently reproduce from source-verified inputs, including unfavorable alternatives.
